query:
SELECT
                a.slug,
                a.name,
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'redirect_uris', o.redirect_uris,
                    'client_secret_hash', o.client_secret_hash,
                    'token_endpoint_auth_method', o.token_endpoint_auth_method
                ) AS "oidc!: Json<ApplicationOidc>"
            FROM applications a
            JOIN applications_oidc o ON o.slug = a.slug
